newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 17.

text.p: LIDOVE NOVINY - At the Social Democratic convention on Saturday, Milos Zeman, received enough votes to hold his position as chairman of the party. Vladimir Spidla was voted in as statutary vice-chairman, Ivo Svoboda as executive vice-chairman, and Petra Buzkova, Zdenek Skromach and Vladislav Schrom as vice-chairmen.

- Vice-chairman of parliament and Agriculture Minister Josef Lux will participate in a collective meeting of EU and Eastern European ministers in Brussels about reforms of veterinary standards and regulations to keep plants at EU's standards.

- Central European Media Enterprises anounced on Friday that it will increase its stake in the Czech Independent Television Company, which controls Nova television, by 5.2 percent to 91.2 percent of broadcasting rights and 93.2 percent of the company's accounts.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Pragobanka and Moravia Banka are the next candidates for entry into the central bank's debt relief plan for small banks, according to Martin Svehla from the CNB. Banka Hana was the first bank to join this programme.
- Health Minister Jan Strasky announced on Saturday that Motol Hospital could be saved by Konsolidacni Banka, which would take on its debts and reverse the effects of its bankruptcy announcement.
- The administrative council of Czech Railways agreed on Friday with Severomoravska Energetika (SME) to pay its debt to SME of 101 million crowns for electricity.
- Skoda Plzen lost a dispute in a commercial court in Plzen with Cimex Trading over 43.5 percent of shares of truck maker Tatra Koprivnice.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - After capital entry into Trinecke Zelezarny, Slovak steel maker VSZ plans to obtain a stake in Skoda Plzen, according to Jozef Marko, a spokesman for VSZ.
- Since 1990, the share of services in the Czech Republic's GDP has increased by approximately 50 percent.
- According to Defence Minister Miloslav Vyborny, the Czech army should sign a contract within the next few weeks with Aero Vodochody for 72 light L-159 fighter aircrafts.

PRAVO - Emergency ward doctors will be able to ask for sponsorship donations from patients from July. This is according to a meeting of the Centre for Primary Care, which includes doctors for adults and children, and the centre for domestic care for patients.

- Interkontakt Group wants to enter the capital market this year. Cooperating with domestic and foreign financial institutions, the group is preparing to issue shares on the Czech capital market and foreign markets.

- Agriculture Minister Josef Lux said that if Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik succeeds in his proposal for budget cuts of 11 billion crowns, the budget for agriculture would be cut by 900 million crowns.
- Czech Airlines (CSA) received two new B 737-500 aircrafts from Boeing's factory in Seattle on Friday.
